title: Signal Merge & Rapid Scope Snapshot for High-Touch Enterprise Requests
creator: Marcos Chen
description: Problem: Sales and CS submit high-touch enterprise feature asks across multiple channels (Zendesk, internal Slack, spreadsheet intake forms). The current process duplicates signals, obscures priority, and slows initial scoping. Objective: Build a repeatable 'signal merge' play that automatically collates related asks into a single intake record, produces a 1-page rapid scope snapshot for PM/ENG review, and surfaces a recommended priority and next-step (proof-of-value, discovery, or out-of-scope). This ticket pilots the play for a subset of top-tier accounts and creates the operational templates and metrics needed to scale.
acceptance_criteria: Inbound signals from Sales/CS for pilot accounts are consolidated into unified intake records with source attribution preserved
PM rapid scope snapshot (1 page) is auto-generated for >= 80% of merged records and stored in the intake drive folder
A lightweight scoring heuristic (impact, effort, fit) produces a recommended priority and next-step label for each snapshot
Pilot stakeholders (2 AE reps, 1 CSM, 1 solutions PM) sign off on the snapshot format and scoring outputs
Runbook documenting when to escalate merged records to discovery and how to create follow-up tickets is published in Confluence
success_metrics: Reduction in duplicate asks routed to PMs by pilot cohort >= 60% within first 4 weeks
Time-to-first-scope (creation of snapshot) reduced from median 5 business days to <= 48 hours
Percentage of merged records with a clear next-step increases to >= 90%
Pilot stakeholder satisfaction score >= 4/5 on snapshot usefulness survey
approach: Define canonical merge keys and fuzzy-matching rules (account, feature keywords, customer impact) with CS and Sales input
Prototype a lightweight scoring rubric combining: customer ARR impact, technical feasibility (eng rough estimate), strategic fit, and repeat frequency
Automate snapshot generation using a templated Google Doc populated from the merged intake record; include links to original tickets/threads
Run a 6-week pilot with 10 strategic accounts; collect qualitative feedback and quantitative metrics
Iterate on format and scoring; hand off final templates and runbook to Ops for broader rollout
